alexa_instructions.title: Copy your Alexa skill configuration
alexa_instructions.description:
**1.** Open the [Alexa Developer Console]({console_url}) and create or open your **Custom** skill. Use **English (UK), en-GB** for this model.

**2.** Copy the complete **Alexa interaction model JSON** from the field below. In **Build → Interaction Model → JSON Editor**, replace the existing JSON, save and **Build Model**. The model includes What's Playing, skip/next song, playback, shuffle and music discovery commands.

**3.** Under **Build → Interfaces**, enable **Audio Player**. Under **Endpoint**, choose **HTTPS** and use `{endpoint_url}` as the default region endpoint, with a valid HTTPS certificate configuration.

**4.** Copy the skill ID from the Alexa console and enter it under Plex Music → Configure → Alexa skill setup. Identify and register each Echo under **Register and name Echo devices**.

**5.** Test with *Alexa, ask Plex Music what's playing* while music is playing.

The wizard prepares configuration; it does not create or deploy an Amazon skill automatically.

alexa_devices.description: Pending devices: {pending_count}. Registered devices: {registered_count}. Say 'Alexa, ask Plex Music to identify this device' on each Echo. Select new devices, enter friendly names and save. Registered devices automatically receive a Status sensor under Plex Music.

alexa_delete_devices.title: Delete registered Alexa devices
alexa_delete_devices.description: Registered devices: {registered_count}. Select the Echo devices to remove from Plex Music and Home Assistant. You can identify them again later using your Alexa skill.

voice_aliases.title: Voice recognition overrides
voice_aliases.description: Correct words Alexa mishears before searching Plex. Enter one mapping per line, for example: gem = Jem. Matching ignores capitalisation and extra spaces. Edit or remove lines to update or delete mappings; leave the field empty to clear all mappings.
